import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from the CSV file
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Create a bar chart of average sales by product
avg_sales_by_product = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['price'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='price', data=avg_sales_by_product)
plt.title('Average Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Average Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a pie chart of sales by payment method
payment_method_counts = coffee_sales['payment_method'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))
plt.pie(payment_method_counts, labels=payment_method_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Sales by Payment Method')
plt.axis('equal')  # Equal aspect ratio ensures that pie is drawn as a circle
plt.savefig('payment_method.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of average sales by customer age group
avg_sales_by_age_group = coffee_sales.groupby('customer_age_group')['price'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='customer_age_group', y='price', data=avg_sales_by_age_group)
plt.title('Average Sales by Customer Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Average Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('age_group.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
